copy.title: Greenway Landscapes — Landscaping, Retaining Walls & Decking, Hills District Sydney
copy.description: Landscaping across The Hills District and north-west Sydney. Retaining walls, timber decking, paving, lawns and turf, drainage and irrigation. A family business since 1987, licence 157365C. Free on-site quote — call Trent on 0418 607 124.
copy.headline:
Every trade
your yard needs.
One call to Trent.
copy.sub: Retaining walls, decks, paving, turf, drainage and irrigation — the whole yard, from one family business in the Hills District since 1987. Licence 157365C, and a free on-site quote.
copy.statementBody: A deck wants a chippie. A wall wants a waller. A wet corner wants someone who can read where the water goes. One of our jobs covered drainage, mulching, steel edging and welding, a drip sprinkler system and earthworks with machinery. Same team for the lot, and one number to ring when you have a question.
copy.servicesHeadline:
The whole yard,
not one part of it.
copy.servicesIntro: The hard parts and the green parts. Retaining walls, decks and paving; turf, garden beds and the drainage underneath them. Water features and garden lighting as well.
copy.apertureLine: One contractor for the whole yard.
copy.workIntro: A hardwood cabana and paver path. Sandstone-look paving past clipped hedging to a verandah. Pavers around a pool and gazebo. A deck wrapped round a weatherboard cottage.
copy.processHeadline:
Four steps,
and the quote is free.
copy.processIntro: We quote on site, at no charge, and the pricing is upfront. You know the number before anything is dug.
copy.reviewsIntro: A 5.0 average from sixteen Google reviews. Every one below names Trent.
copy.recognitionIntro: Licence 157365C. Current members of the Housing Industry Association and the Landscape Association NSW & ACT. And in 2004 we won the Landscape category in the Australian Achiever awards for Excellence in Customer Service.
copy.areasHeadline:
The Hills District,
and out from there.
copy.areasIntro: Based around Castle Hill, serving the Hills District, north-west Sydney and the Sydney metro area. Not sure you are in range? Ring Trent and ask.
copy.enquireIntro: The more you can tell us about the block — the slope, the corner that stays wet, what you actually want out there — the more useful the first visit will be. Photos help.

faq.q: Do you come out and quote?
faq.a: Yes, and it costs nothing. Book the job and we will organise a free on-site quotation.

faq.q: How small a job will you take?
faq.a: Small is fine. We take large and small scale projects, residential and commercial. One of our Google reviews is for a replaced deck and a turfed nature strip.

faq.q: Our side yard floods. Can that be sorted before anything is planted?
faq.a: Yes. One customer's review describes us listening to their concerns about a side area flooding, then putting in extra drainage pipes and bigger river rocks and a better design around it. Another lists identifying and resolving drainage issues among the work on their job.

Yes. Licence 157365C. We carry public liability and workers' compensation, and we are eligible for Builders Warranty Insurance. We are also current members of the Housing Industry Association and the Landscape Association NSW & ACT.
The Hills District, north-west Sydney and the Sydney metro area, from a Castle Hill base. If you are not sure whether you are in range, ring Trent and ask.

faq.q: Do you do the whole yard, or just one part of it?
faq.a: Either. Paving and driveways, pool surrounds, garden design and construction, irrigation and water features, pergolas, retaining walls and excavation work. One Google review describes a single job that covered drainage, garden mulching, steel edging and welding, a drip sprinkler system and earthworks using machinery.

faq.q: How long have you been going?
faq.a: We are a family business, established in 1987 — over thirty years' experience. In 2004 we won the Landscape category in the Australian Achiever awards for Excellence in Customer Service.

_source.aboutText:
Greenway Landscapes is a family business established in 1987. One of our priorities is quality of workmanship and we make sure the job is done properly the first time without cutting corners.

We also place great importance on communication with clients and good service which was recognized in 2004 when Greenway Landscapes won the Landscape category in the Australian Achiever awards for Excellence in Customer Service. Our business has all the required licenses and insurance in place including public liability, workers’ compensation and eligibility for Builders Warranty Insurance.

We are also current members of the Housing Industry Association and the Landscape Association NSW & ACT.

Greenway Landscapes can meet your needs in all aspects of Landscape construction including paving, retaining walls, driveways, drainage and irrigation, water features, decking, pergolas, garden edging and construction and much more.

We are happy to be involved as little or as much as you would like with the design of your outdoor areas.

Residential & Commercial: Paving & Driveways, Pool Surrounds, Garden Design & Construction, Irrigation & Water Features, Pergolas, Retaining Walls, Excavation Work
